headline: Analysts trim outlook for Westmere Electronics on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Westmere Electronics, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Westmere Electronics faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Westmere Electronics. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Westmere Electronics reports minor shipment delays at Leipzig plant
body: Westmere Electronics confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Leipzig plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Westmere Electronics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Westmere Electronics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Westmere Electronics publishes annual sustainability report
body: Westmere Electronics released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Westmere Electronics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Westmere Electronics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Leipzig. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Westmere Electronics opens new production line in Leipzig
body: Westmere Electronics commissioned a new line at its Leipzig site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.
